thread:
Zoe (Partnerships): Idea: run a hybrid "lab crate" pilot for SIs — ship a small HW kit + sandbox access, then run a 3-hour remote proctored lab that certs them on marketplace deploy, private/VPC setup, and model rollback drills. This would help smaller integrators who can't travel. Thoughts?
Dmitri (SI Programs): Interesting. Hybrid reduces travel friction. How many kits can we ship for pilot? Also need clear pass criteria and reattempt flow.
Rina (HW Partnerships): We can assemble 12 kits (RPI-size with NIC + SSD) for pilot. Need sign-off on shipping terms and a waiver for customs. Also ensure kit images are minimal and don't include sensitive keys.
Kareem (DevEx): For the remote lab we can provide an automated proctor script that verifies environment + runs the exercises. Proctoring options: live proctor via Zoom or automated checks + short recording upload. Prefer automated to scale.
Nelly (Marketplace): Marketplace station can be 20m: create a sandbox listing, attach manifest, and run an end-to-end deploy that hits the partner sandbox. We can pre-seed test manifests. Need to ensure listing flow works with the kit network setup.
LegalBot: Reminder: any shipped hardware requires signed terms; sandbox use must be restricted to synthetic data. Please collect signed agreement before shipping.
Zoe (Partnerships): Good call. We'll add a checkbox in registration. For scope: pilot cohort of 6 integrators, 2 kits each (so they can pair program). Timeline: ship kits two weeks before remote lab.
Dmitri (SI Programs): Drafting rubrics: pass = complete 3 stations + evidence (logs/screenshots) within session window. Fail -> 1-week reattempt. Also propose issuing a "Lab Certified" badge for passing.
Kareem (DevEx): I'll prepare the starter repo + a preflight script partners run to verify they can reach sandboxes and the kit can NAT to the VPN. Example preflight:
```bash
# preflight checks
curl -sS https://sandbox.redwood.ai/health | jq .status
ssh pi@KIT_IP 'curl -sS https://sandbox.redwood.ai/kit-health'
```
Rina (HW Partnerships): Shipping note: include a simple ethernet cable and a USB power bank. We'll include a laminated quickstart with serial numbers. Also plan for a return label in the box.
Nelly (Marketplace): On the marketplace side, I'll provision per-team tenants and pre-create a sample SKU so partners can focus on manifest & integration rather than infra. Also will prepare a checklist card for post-lab reference.
Zoe (Partnerships): Ops: registration + legal sign-off -> deadline 2026-06-01. Ship by 2026-06-10. Run remote labs on 2026-06-24. Volunteers to proctor live channels during the event? We'll do a async Slack channel + a small live ops crew.
Dmitri (SI Programs): I can own proctor rotation schedule and scoring. Recommend 1 proctor per 2 teams.
Kareem (DevEx): I'll own the automation & evidence bundle creator. Evidence bundle: zipped logs + screenshots + a small JSON manifest of results. Example manifest fields: participant_email, station_id, result, artifacts_url. (I'll output as downloadable artifact for LMS ingestion.)
Rina (HW Partnerships): Who handles hardware failures mid-pilot? Proposal: on-call engineer for same-day RMA/replace; include spare kits for quick swap. We should lock spare pool size: 2 kits.
Zoe (Partnerships): Good. Budget note: shipping + kits + badges. I'll get finance an estimate. Also need to confirm marketplace sandbox quotas. Nelly, can you check quota bump?
Nelly (Marketplace): Yes, I'll request quota increase and confirm by EOD Thu.
LegalBot: Draft shipping waiver and sandbox TOU updated. Partners must sign before we ship.
Dmitri (SI Programs): Communication plan: registration page, preflight checklist, short orientation video, and the kit quickstart. Also a short 5-min recorded walkthrough of the exercises for partners to watch prior to event.
Kareem (DevEx): I'll record a 5-min "what to expect" screencast and host it on our private S3. Also will wire the preflight script to run as a GitHub Actions check to help partners validate early.
Zoe (Partnerships): Action items: Zoe -> registration + shipping logistics (due 2026-05-10); Dmitri -> rubric + proctor schedule (due 2026-05-12); Rina -> kit BOM + spare pool (due 2026-05-08); Kareem -> starter repo + preflight script + evidence bundle format (due 2026-05-12); Nelly -> sandbox quota + tenant prep (due 2026-05-06); LegalBot -> waiver + TOU text (due 2026-05-04).
Dmitri (SI Programs): One more thought: include a short "fail-safe" exercise where partners practice routing to a cheaper model variant to observe cost vs latency tradeoffs. Good real-world tie-in.
Kareem (DevEx): I'll add that as optional bonus station. We'll have a snippet to switch routing policy via API:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/route -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROVISION" -d '{"policy":"cost-saver","weights":{"v1":0.2,"cheap-quant":0.8}}'
```
Rina (HW Partnerships): I'll create a tiny troubleshooting card for common kit issues (power, microSD image, network).
Zoe (Partnerships): OK locking plan. If we can get legal + quotas by next week, we'll open registration. Thanks team! :shipit:
